title: Freehand design study
question: Compare the dark layouts. Pick one, combine parts, or ask for another pass. Sample transcripts are fictional.

options.label: Index
options.lineage: Contemporary library catalogues and digital reading rooms
options.thesis: Browse history on one side and read the selected transcript on the other.
options.viewport: A narrow navigation rail, searchable history list, and a separate transcript reading pane.
options.risk: Three areas may feel too structured for occasional history use.

options.label: Compact
options.lineage: Modern wayfinding clarity and compact desktop utilities

options.risk: Familiar and efficient; longer transcripts may make the single column feel tall.
